text:
Marisa: Heads-up from the lease-swap chaos sims — we keep losing writes when ownership flips mid-request. Not comfortable with silent loss. Pitch: proxy writes a tiny, durable escrow record and becomes a delegate that replays to the authoritative owner instead of doing a synchronous lease swap. Pros/cons?

alex: Sounds like a good safety net. Cons: extra 10-200ms tail for some requests and a tiny local storage surface. How do we avoid double-apply and keep ordering?

marisa: Use a signed write_token + shard_seq. Replay is at-least-once but target checks token+seq window to dedupe and enforce causal ordering. If gap detected target can fetch missing ops before applying.

devon: Big legal constraint: EU-only tenants must never leave region. Escrow must include residency_policy and proxy must enforce routing. If no permitted destination exists, quarantine and page ops.

marisa: Agreed. Escrow payload will contain residency_policy, tenant_consent flags, and owner_hint. Quarantined escrows are visible in ops UI and generate an incident when threshold exceeded.

sam: Single-node escrow risk? If the proxy holding escrow crashes during a multi-region outage we could still lose writes. What's the replication plan?

marisa: Keep escrow tiny and replicated synchronously to one local standby proxy (replication=2). Also ship lightweight metadata (ids, tenant, state) async to control plane for visibility/alerting. TTLs short (default 3m) so capacity is bounded.

nina: Observability requirements: per-tenant escrow_inflight, p95_forward_latency, quarantined_count, forward_retry_count. Include forward_attempt_id in traces and capture who/which proxy forwarded.

alex: Client UX: do we block clients? I prefer non-blocking default.

marisa: Default returns 202 + X-Write-Token after local escrow commit. Background forwarder retries until success/quarantine. Provide ?sync=true for callers needing immediate confirmation — that'll block until target ack. Also provide status endpoint: GET /escrow/{token}.

devon: SLAs and thresholds? Need numbers for runbooks/tests.

marisa: Proposal: default completion p95 < 30s, page at 2m, quarantine after 5m. Forward_retry_limit = 6 with exponential backoff. Quarantine retention 14d for audit. Ops-bot, confirm defaults?

ops-bot: [automation] set values: escrow_replication=2; default_ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=6; quarantine_retention_days=14.

sam: How to handle deletes/tombstones arriving while write is escrowed? Must preserve causal semantics.

marisa: All ops carry shard_seq. Replayer applies in seq order; if tombstone has higher priority, the replay will be deduped/skip. We'll make seq validation strict during replay.

nina: Compliance: every cross-region forward must emit audit event (proxy-id, operator-id if manual, timestamps, outcome). Provide export API for legal e-discovery.

alex: Edge-case: forward loops where both sides think the other owns shard. Need deterministic handshake with owner validation and a clear retry/escalation path.

marisa: Handshake plan: forwarder POSTs /handoff with signed token + seq_span. Target validates token signature and current ownership. If mismatch, return 409 + owner_hint. Forwarder follows owner_hint or escalates after retry limit. Example:

POST /handoff HTTP/1.1
Host: region-eu1.proxy
Content-Type: application/json
{ "write_token": "wt-2026", "shard": "s-42", "seq_span": [1001,1003], "residency": "eu-only" }

marisa: Tokens are short-lived (TTL) and signed by proxy key to prevent spoofing. Target rejects unsigned/expired tokens.

alex: Operator tooling: we need a quarantined-escrows panel, manual-forward button (with owner_hint selection), and a safe re-route workflow that requires two-person approval for cross-regional apply on sovereign tenants.

marisa: Good call. Also an automated remediation job that attempts operator-approved cross-region forwards on quarantined items (runs only after explicit opt-in per-tenant).

ops-bot: [automation] runbook-check: quarantine_alert_threshold=300s; manual_forward_requires_approval=true.

sam: Implementation rough breakdown?

marisa: Proxy escrow API + in-region storage shim, token signer, forwarder worker, target handoff endpoint + dedupe/apply logic, ops UI + audit export. Estimate: 4 weeks core + 2 weeks integration + legal + runbook in parallel.

devon: I'll draft the failure-mode matrix and operator playbook (including how to surface quarantines to SRE and support).

nina: I'll mock dashboards and audit export format.

marisa: I'll write the RFC patch with interface contract, token format, sequence diagrams, and rollout phases. Proposal: prototype in staging for non-sovereign tenants in the next sprint. Tagging @alex @devon @sam @nina — will share RFC link when ready.
